The '''Balamak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balamak/Legends|Balamak]].
